where.if: (upper(code) like #{s.like} or upper(customer_name) like #{s.like} or upper(coalesce(tracking_code, '')) like #{s.like} or upper(coalesce(channel_ref, '')) like #{s.like} or phone like #{s.like})

mapper.select: select max(code) from oms.orders where code like #{prefix} || '%'
mapper.insert: insert into oms.orders (code, channel, channel_ref, customer_name, phone, amount, cod_amount, pay_via, tracking_code, status, remote_area, created_at, note) values (#{code}, #{channel}, #{channelRef}, #{customerName}, #{phone}, #{amount}, #{codAmount}, #{payVia}, #{trackingCode}, 'NEW', #{remoteArea}, now(), #{note})
mapper.update: update oms.orders set status = #{status}, tracking_code = coalesce(#{trackingCode}, tracking_code), delivered_at = case when #{status} = 'DELIVERED' then coalesce(delivered_at, now()) else delivered_at end where code = #{code}
mapper.select: select status, count(*)::int as total from oms.orders group by status order by status

select g.method, g.created_at as matched_at, p.external_ref, p.source_code from match_items mi join match_groups g on g.id = mi.group_id left join payment_lines p on p.match_group_id = g.id where mi.order_code = #{code} limit 1
select username, password_sha256, full_name from oms.staff where username = #{username}
